name: CData
description: Drivers and connectors so Excel, Tableau, Power BI, and other apps can query more than 270 sources, including QuickBooks, Salesforce, and NetSuite, as if each one were a database. Google, Salesforce, and Informatica embed the connectors. Chapel Hill, North Carolina. Amit Sharma is the CEO. The photo is the logo.

mentions.evidence: Reuters, on 26 June 2024, said the company expected about $100 million a year by the end of 2024, and that it was growing more than 40 percent a year. That figure is an expectation, not a finished year. A source put the valuation above $800 million, and a valuation is not revenue. It raised about $350 million led by Warburg Pincus and Accel, after $160 million from Updata, and that money is funding, not revenue. The company says it has been profitable since it was founded, with more than 7,000 customers.
mentions.indieAngle: One awkward source, done properly, then sold to the vendors as well.

whyItPrints: APIs change, and every reporting tool needs to read every system. CData sells to IT teams and to the software vendors who hide the connector inside their own product.
whyThisMatters: Every reporting tool needs to read every other system, and those systems do not share one format.
